title: North Korea denies involvement in $6 B Binance crypto platform heist

blocks.text: North Korea denied a U.S. accusation that it was involved in the theft of assets worth more than $6 billion from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange platform last week, state media reported Tuesday. In a statement dated Monday, Kim Yo Jong, the sister of the country’s leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the accusation by the U.S.
